title: Index tooth and pocket wheel
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The driving tooth is inside the follower pocket. The two external pitch arcs roll in opposite senses. A positive, B negative. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).
